record.question: One Acre = Square Yards.
record.explanation: One acre contains43560 square feet. Since1 square yard=9 square feet,43560/9=4840 square yards. Reference: https://www.nist.gov/system/files/documents/2017/05/09/HB44-09-Combined.pdf. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
